_about: F59 unlock lesson: the start of the first shift at rank 1 or more (the next-piece window unlocks at progression.json unlocks.nextPiece). An interrupt: the shift waits under it, the window outlined, until Got it. Once per device (Settings → Replay lessons plays it again); one unlock lesson per shift start (src/game/lessons/unlockLessons.ts). Words: content/text/en.json → lessons.unlock-window.
